accounts-and-households: C10 (real iPhone/iPad Chrome, viewports, Carbon theme, keyboard types) cannot run in this in-process suite; scripts/acceptance.py has no manual-criterion marker, so `map --strict` keeps reporting it unmapped. It needs the Playwright e2e or a manual check.
C7: the admin reset command for a one-member household (node scripts/reset-password.mjs) runs against remote D1 and is not tested in-process.

C8/C5: rooms, items and photos arrive with HR-8/HR-2; the isolation test seeds them by SQL only when those tables exist (ADR 0013 columns), and the 409 'household already holds data' case only runs when a rooms table exists.

Interface assumptions not fixed by PRD or ADR 0013 are listed in tests/acceptance/accounts-and-households/INTERFACE.md (rename route PATCH /api/household, mustChangePassword in GET /api/me, invite token location, password change body).
